args.title: checkout-api failing health checks after v2.3.1 deploy
args.summary: checkout-api has been failing health checks since the latest deploy (v2.3.1, error rate 0.18). Rolled back in all production regions to the most recent healthy release, v2.2.9 (v2.3.0 was quarantined due to CVE-2026-4417). Rollback verified in us-east, us-west, and eu-west.

trace.final:
I rolled back checkout-api and opened an incident.

**What I did:**
1. Confirmed checkout-api was unhealthy (v2.3.1, error rate 0.18) across all three regions.
2. Attempted rollback to v2.3.0 (the most recent healthy release), but it was rejected — v2.3.0 is quarantined due to CVE-2026-4417.
3. Rolled back to v2.2.9 (the next most recent healthy production release) in all regions — verified rolled out in us-east, us-west, and eu-west.
4. Opened SEV2 incident **INC-0001** describing the failure and the rollback, paging on-call.

Note: v2.3.0 could not be used because it's quarantined, so the service is now on v2.2.9.
